create_Color: create a Color instance with RGBA coordinates and access r, g, b, a properties
create_Vector: create a Vector from coordinates and access x, y, z, w properties or compare two vectors
create_Quaternion: create a Quaternion from coordinates and access x, y, z, w properties or rotate a Vector
create_Matrix: create a Matrix instance and extract its translation vector, quaternion, or scale vector
create_Matrix_Diagonal: create a diagonal Matrix using the Matrix.Diagonal class method
